title: Not a pizza cutter
text:
Not a pizza cutter. I don’t think this is for cutting Pizza or anything.
There is nothing that is sharp on this spatula to cut pizza, and it’s very narrow.
But it looks like what I have for icing a cake with, except this is not stiff enough and could fling icing back in my face, also it’s too long.

The handle is a hard plastic, although together it seems make ok.

Giving this a 2 star because this was misrepresented, but I might find a use for this , then I’ll update this review.
